name: "Everything Spice" Crusted Salmon with Avocado, Cucumber & Caper Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 English cucumbers
3 avocados
1 small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Place seeds and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the "everything spice" mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp sesame seeds
1 tbsp poppy seeds
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on the baking sheet. Spread with Dijon, then sprinkle evenly with the spice mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
3 tbsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Place fish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, capers, and salt in a large bowl; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
3 tbsp capers
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice onions crosswise into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon into the bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the salmon and salad between plates. Enjoy!
